actual: Current MiniQMT simulation runtime still exposes local qmt_strategy position lots as strategy quantities that can diverge from MiniQMT merged positions. Live read-only API evidence on 2026-06-17 shows simrun_ca7abfe9f74bf98f is SUCCEEDED while carrying 43 POSITION_MISMATCH records, and simrun_ebf382bde34bf3f9 remains INTRADAY_RUNNING with 43 POSITION_MISMATCH records plus sell-proceeds/capacity residuals. Examples include broker_quantity=0 with positive strategy_quantity. This indicates AIstock strategy-slot holdings are still treated as independently persisted position state rather than a pure projection of MiniQMT authority.

expected: MiniQMT account ledger is the only authoritative source for account cash, frozen cash, holdings, can_sell, orders and trades. AIstock persists a MiniQMT total-ledger mirror from MiniQMT APIs and derives strategy-slot position projections from that ledger plus deterministic attribution. Strategy-slot projections cannot exist as independent position facts; if attribution is incomplete, unmatched quantities must be reported as unattributed/pending instead of being treated as strategy-owned holdings. Execution preflight, sell-first proceeds, run status and reconciliation must use broker-authoritative positions, and POSITION_MISMATCH cannot coexist with SUCCEEDED unless proven out-of-scope and moved to unattributed evidence.
